newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-DENVER NUGGETS FIRE HEAD COACH DICK MOTTA AND STAFF.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-DENVER NUGGETS FIRE HEAD COACH DICK MOTTA AND STAFF.

text.p: The Denver Nuggets, who just completed the second-worst season in team history, fired head coach Dick Motta and his entire staff on Monday.
Motta and assistants Jim Brovelli, Gene Littles and Kip Motta, son of the head coach, were relieved of their duties after guiding the team to a 21-61 record, the Nuggets announced.

The 65-year-old Motta had replaced Bernie Bickerstaff, who stepped down as head coach November 26. But the team went just 17-52 under Motta with just five victories coming after the mid-season All-Star break.
The Nuggets, who closed the season with a 100-95 win at Dallas Sunday, never seemed to recover from the loss of centre Dikembe Mutombo to free agency prior to the season.
In addition, forward LaPhonso Ellis was limited by injuries to 55 games and Sarunas Maciulionis appeared in just 17 games due to injuries.
Motta, who had one-year remaining on his Denver contract, came to the Nuggets from the Dallas Mavericks, where he posted 329 wins in nine seasons.
He is the second NBA coaching casualty in as many days after the Philadelphia 76ers fired Johnny Davis on Sunday.
